title: Unemployment Insurance Appeals: Dismissal and Reopening
content:
An appeal under Unemployment Insurance Appeals is dismissed as untimely when it was filed late without good cause or after the late appeal limit, and dismissed for default when the appellant does not answer the hearing call within the call wait minutes; when only the other party is absent the hearing proceeds. A dismissed appeal may be reopened when the appellant asks for reopening with good cause. Reopening is granted only when it is requested no later than the reopening window after the mailing date of the dismissal. The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the mailing date of the dismissal, and a request on the last day is in time. Good cause and the merits are heard at the same reopened hearing where the docket combines them; a reopening request that is late or shows no good cause is denied and the dismissal stands.

## Grounds of dismissal

| Ground | What happened |
|---|---|
| untimely | filed late without good cause, or filed after the late appeal limit |
| default | the appellant did not answer the hearing call within the call wait minutes |

When only the other party is absent there is no dismissal: the hearing proceeds. A dismissal is mailed, and the appeal stands at dismissed status. Where the dismissed appeal was against an overpayment determination, recovery of that overpayment resumes.

## The reopening window

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | the mailing date of the dismissal: on a dismissed appeal, the decision mailing date on the Department's record of the appeal is the date the dismissal was mailed |
| Length | the docket's reopening request period, in calendar days |
| Counting | day 1 is the day after the mailing date of the dismissal |
| Direction and boundary | the request is in time when made no later than the last day; a request on the last day is in time |

*Boundary case (hypothetical dates and a hypothetical window of 15 days):* a dismissal is mailed on Monday 2 March 2026. Day 1 is Tuesday 3 March and day 15 is Tuesday 17 March. A reopening request made on 17 March is in time; one made on Wednesday 18 March is late.

## Decision on a reopening request

| Requested within the window | Good cause shown | Result |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | reopening may be granted; where the docket combines them, good cause and the merits are heard at the same reopened hearing |
| yes | no | denied; the dismissal stands |
| no | yes | denied; the dismissal stands |
| no | no | denied; the dismissal stands |

A granted reopening returns the appeal from dismissed to scheduled status with a hearing set on reopening.
